note: Pinned TTS sources for Phase-7 reception audio (P7 §27-37). Hashes are written by the reception-audio workflow's recon mode from a double-download that must agree byte-for-byte, then verified fail-closed on every later run. Model weights are NEVER committed to this repository — only these pins, the model cards, and the generated audio assets. The Piper engine itself is MIT (rhasspy/piper @ 73c04d81d5590ecc46e522de3601ce7fb29fc2be, VERSION 1.2.0).

licenseGate.note: Recon fails closed unless every voice's MODEL_CARD states a dataset/license matched by allow and matched by no deny entry (P7 §31, §37). The allow list mirrors the project-wide LICENSE_ALLOWLIST posture (content/schema.ts): CC BY 4.0 and CC BY-SA 4.0 in text or URL form. Share-alike is accepted deliberately — the project already publishes derived data under CC BY-SA 4.0 with an in-app attributions screen (see content/sources/registry.json entries piper-voice-*); AGPL/GPL/NC/ND remain denied.
